title: Explicit recursion laws for integral expression comparisons
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with l ≠ char D, simultaneous operations o and canonical ambient models a. There is a family c_e : L(e_system(R inputs)) ≅ e_integral(inputs), natural on each full admissible finite geometric expression domain, satisfying inverse actual unit at variables, the conjugate proper-image recursion, counit-normalized canonical K-flat pull and tensor recursions, the specified ambient open realization recursion, and exactly proper-after-open recursion at compact-support vertices. No structural-generator square or finite scalar projection is asserted.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument of lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization

proof.text: Use unrestricted normalized reconstruction for the specified adjunction to invert its counit on every Good intermediate system. For an integral input use its completeness clause, the derived-completeness/legacy comparison at an auxiliary finite field of characteristic different from l, and unrestricted reconstruction to invert the actual unit. The leaf comparison is its inverse.

On any full input-family category, whisker the actual counit by the system-input functor; its components are invertible by step 1. For pullback invert its image under pull followed by total limit, then compose with the published integral pullback model inverse. For tensor do the same with the pair of counits and the published integral tensor model inverse. These are natural isomorphisms, and multiplying by the relevant counit image gives the required pull and tensor laws by cancellation.

Use a.realizationModel.push for proper image. For open extension use a.openRealization on the recorded Good input and output domain. Write its normalization as q d u = L r. The maps q = L J(counit), u and L r are natural. The map q is invertible by step 1. The triangle identity makes the unit at L J M invertible because J M is Good; unit naturality along the open realization isomorphism then makes u invertible. Cancel q on the left and u on the right in the naturality square to prove naturality of d. No identification with a separately selected realization model is necessary.

Define comparisons by structural recursion on the typed expression. Restrict each child along the full-domain inclusion given by the corresponding admissibility conjunct, then whisker and compose with the constructor comparisons of steps 1--3. Pair the two natural child isomorphisms for tensor; repeated inputs require no new hypothesis. At a chosen compactification compose the open and proper comparisons, retaining the hidden open Good witness. The leaf, proper and open laws are the defining formulas, pull and tensor are inverse cancellation, and the compactification law follows from preservation of composition by proper image.

    (o : Operations l E) (a : AmbientModels l E o) :
    ∃ c : ExpressionRecursion.Comparisons l E D o, Nonempty (RecursionLaws l E D o a c)
